nodes.description: _rOwned mapping holding reflection balances used by the token accounting
_tOwned mapping (declared, unused, legacy reflection storage)
_allowances nested mapping of owner to spender approvals
_isExcludedFromFee mapping controlling which accounts bypass tax
bots mapping of addresses blocked from transferring
cooldown mapping storing per-address timestamp gate
_rTotal total reflection supply, reduced by _reflectFee
_taxFee reflection tax percentage applied on transfers
_teamFee team/marketing tax percentage applied on transfers
_FeeAddress payable address receiving half of the swapped ETH
_marketingWalletAddress payable address receiving half of the swapped ETH
uniswapV2Router reference set in openTrading
uniswapV2Pair LP token address created in openTrading
tradingOpen flag enabling public trading
inSwap reentrancy guard flag used by lockTheSwap
swapEnabled flag controlling automatic contract-token swaps
cooldownEnabled flag controlling timestamp based anti-snipe delay
_maxTxAmount maximum amount of tokens buyable in one transaction
_owner privileged address of the Ownable base contract
_tTotal constant total token supply 1e12 * 10**9
_tFeeTotal accumulated distributed tax tokens
_previousTaxFee stored reflection tax before fee removal
_previousteamFee stored team tax before fee removal
_msgSender() internal view wrapper returning msg.sender
owner() view returning the Ownable _owner address
renounceOwnership() onlyOwner, sets _owner to address(0)
name() returns the constant token name
symbol() returns the constant token symbol
decimals() returns 9
totalSupply() returns the constant _tTotal
balanceOf(address) converts reflection balance to token balance
transfer() public ERC20 entry point calling _transfer from msg.sender
allowance() view returning stored allowances
approve() public entry point calling _approve with msg.sender as owner
transferFrom() public entry point forwarding to _transfer and _approve
setCooldownEnabled(bool) onlyOwner toggle for the cooldown gate
tokenFromReflection() private view converting rAmount to token amount
removeAllFee() private, zeroes tax fees after backing them up
restoreAllFee() private, restores backed up tax fees
_approve() private writing the _allowances mapping
_transfer() private core transfer logic with fees, bots, cooldown, swap and ETH payout
swapTokensForEth() private swap of contract tokens to ETH via Uniswap, guarded by lockTheSwap
sendETHToFee() private splits ETH balance and pushes to two wallets
openTrading() onlyOwner sets router, creates pair, adds liquidity and enables swaps
setBots(address[]) onlyOwner marks addresses as bots
delBot(address) onlyOwner clears a bot flag
_tokenTransfer() private wraps fee removal/restore around _transferStandard
_transferStandard() private updates reflection balances and emits Transfer
_takeTeam() private credits team fee reflections to the contract
_reflectFee() private reduces _rTotal and accumulates _tFeeTotal
receive() external payable accepting plain ETH transfers
manualswap() restricted to _FeeAddress, swaps contract token balance
manualsend() restricted to _FeeAddress, sends contract ETH balance to fee wallets
_getValues() private view computing r/t values for a transfer
_getTValues() private pure computing token fee splits
_getRValues() private pure computing reflection fee amounts
_getRate() private view computing rSupply/tSupply rate
_getCurrentSupply() private view returning current r and t supply
setMaxTxPercent(uint256) onlyOwner recomputes _maxTxAmount
msg.sender attacker controllable caller identity
block.timestamp miner influenced time value

external payable call to router.addLiquidityETH spending contract ETH
ETH push to _FeeAddress via transfer()
ETH push to _marketingWalletAddress via transfer()
external call to IUniswapV2Factory.createPair
external call IERC20(uniswapV2Pair).approve granting max allowance to router

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by the _msgSender wrapper
transfer() uses _msgSender() as the sender of the tokens
approve() uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance deduction
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _FeeAddress, so caller identity gates the swap
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _FeeAddress, so caller identity gates the ETH payout
openTrading is gated by onlyOwner which compares _owner with _msgSender()
setCooldownEnabled is gated by onlyOwner using _msgSender()
setBots is gated by onlyOwner using _msgSender()
delBot is gated by onlyOwner using _msgSender()
setMaxTxPercent is gated by onlyOwner using _msgSender()
renounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner using _msgSender()
_transfer compares cooldown[to] with block.timestamp enabling miner influenced timing
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline
transfer() delegates to the private _transfer implementation
transferFrom() delegates to the private _transfer implementation
transferFrom() calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance
approve() calls _approve to write the allowance
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer with the computed takeFee flag
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard for the actual balance moves
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when fees are not taken
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after a fee free transfer
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute r/t amounts
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to credit team fees
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to burn reflection fees
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call before sender/recipient balances are updated
_transfer pushes ETH out via sendETHToFee before the token balances for the transfer are settled
swapTokensForEth calls _approve to allow the router to spend contract tokens
openTrading calls _approve to authorise the router for the whole supply
_getValues calls _getTValues for the token side amounts
_getValues calls _getRValues for the reflection side amounts
_getValues calls _getRate for the current reflection rate
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply to obtain r and t supply
balanceOf calls tokenFromReflection to convert the stored reflection balance
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the whole contract token balance
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the whole contract ETH balance
_transfer path updates _rOwned balances through _transferStandard and _takeTeam
_transfer writes _taxFee for the current transfer
_transfer writes _teamFee for the current transfer
_transfer reads bots[from] and bots[to] to block flagged addresses
_transfer reads and writes cooldown[to] to enforce a timestamp based anti-bot delay
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to detect buys and sells
_transfer checks swapEnabled before swapping accumulated tokens
_transfer checks inSwap to avoid nested swaps
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount on buys
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to decide takeFee
removeAllFee sets _taxFee to zero
removeAllFee sets _teamFee to zero
removeAllFee backs up _taxFee into _previousTaxFee
removeAllFee backs up _teamFee into _previousteamFee
restoreAllFee restores _taxFee
restoreAllFee restores _teamFee
restoreAllFee reads _previousTaxFee
restoreAllFee reads _previousteamFee
_transferStandard subtracts rAmount from sender and adds rTransferAmount to recipient in _rOwned
_takeTeam credits rTeam to _rOwned[address(this)] minting team reflections
_reflectFee performs _rTotal.sub(rFee) reflection supply arithmetic
_reflectFee performs _tFeeTotal.add(tFee) accumulation arithmetic
tokenFromReflection requires rAmount <= _rTotal before dividing
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal to derive rSupply
_getCurrentSupply reads the constant _tTotal
sendETHToFee transfers half of the amount to _FeeAddress
sendETHToFee transfers half of the amount to _marketingWalletAddress
openTrading stores the Uniswap V2 router address
openTrading stores the created pair address
openTrading enables automatic swaps
openTrading enables the timestamp cooldown gate
openTrading sets the initial _maxTxAmount
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true
openTrading/constructor mark the token contract as fee excluded
setCooldownEnabled writes cooldownEnabled
setBots writes true into the bots mapping for each supplied address
delBot clears the bots mapping entry for an address
setMaxTxPercent recomputes _maxTxAmount with _tTotal.mul(maxTxPercent).div(100)
swapTokensForEth is wrapped in lockTheSwap which toggles inSwap
renounceOwnership sets the privileged _owner to address(0)
owner() returns the stored _owner address
swapTokensForEth performs an untrusted external router call while the calling transfer state is not yet finalised
swapTokensForEth queries the router for the WETH address used in the swap path
openTrading calls factory().createPair and then approves the pair for the max uint
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH forwarding the contract ETH balance
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to _FeeAddress before the surrounding transfer accounting completes
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to _marketingWalletAddress before the surrounding transfer accounting completes
the ETH transfer to _FeeAddress can invoke the recipient receive()/fallback enabling reentry
the ETH transfer to _marketingWalletAddress can invoke the recipient receive()/fallback enabling reentry
the Uniswap router swap calls back into the token transfer logic which can re-enter _transfer
transfers of the LP pair token trigger _transfer on the counterparty allowing external contracts to hook the flow

normalization_plan.reason: parameter from is only used inside _transfer so it is folded into the _transfer function node
parameter to is only used inside _transfer so it is folded into the _transfer function node
parameter amount is only used inside _transfer so it is folded into the _transfer function node
local contractTokenBalance is consumed as the tokenAmount argument of swapTokensForEth
parameter tokenAmount flows directly into the external swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call
parameter amount of sendETHToFee is split and forwarded to the two fee wallet transfers inside sendETHToFee
parameter recipient of the public transfer function is passed straight through to _transfer from transfer
parameter sender of _transferStandard is only used inside _transferStandard
parameter recipient of _transferStandard is only used inside _transferStandard
parameter tAmount of _transferStandard is only used inside _transferStandard
parameter bots_ is only iterated inside setBots to populate the bots mapping
parameter maxTxPercent is only used inside setMaxTxPercent to rescale _maxTxAmount
local contractBalance of manualswap is immediately passed to swapTokensForEth
parameter account of balanceOf is only used to index _rOwned inside balanceOf
